transcript_chunks.body: Where did the 60% threshold for the cross-encoder come from? Is it a tunable knob or a methodology constant?

Methodology constant. The 60% threshold was sourced from the binding-measurement design, not from operational corpus tuning — moving it to fit a marginal observed value would invalidate the pre-commitment discipline that protects the verdict from goalpost shifts.
